state_contract.mt95: caller-owned class, genrand_state by value (624 uint32 words, cnt, ini); Native scalar seed/array/state initialization and all six signed/conversion streams; no global state
state_contract.latin_hypercube_arrays_state: case-owned permutation Int2D plus Native prior_iter diagnostic; cleanup releases only permutation
state_contract.parameters_silhs_state: existing prescribed 8 probabilities + importance_prob_thresh + vert_decorr_coef, no duplicate global settings
state_contract.generate_silhs_sample_api: all Native arguments in order incl optional f2k::stats_type*, then sampling_state&, mt95&, const parameters_silhs_state&

scope_notes: Retain full straight-MC, LH, old cloud-weighted private branch, all 3 clustered strategies, limit/normalize/variance fraction choices, start-height and independent-all-level branches; no JAX blanket exclusion.
Retain Native CPU MT95 generator on all C++ backends; external Native CUDA/CURAND option is superseded by actual portable C++ RNG, not delegated. Native CPU draw order is acceptance target.
Retain actual compile-time false l_clip_hydromet_samples and two optional 2D sample-output branches; no runtime enable invented. True stats I/O remains existing Native backend.
Native all-level LH traversal is column then level; JAX scan is level then column. Port follows Native.
Native output Ncn_all_points is unwritten if iiPDF_Ncn<=0; JAX zeros it. Do not silently adopt JAX zero.
Native cdfnorminv a/b unsuffixed coefficients must round as default Fortran real before core conversion; no speculative BFB workaround.
JAX ltqnorm guards/clips invalid inactive branches and returns NaN; Native ordinary formulas/endpoints/Halley remain authority.
RNG dependent draws and permutations remain ordered C++ host work on case state; independent sample transforms/stat math use Kokkos. No scalar bridge/device crossings.
